description: This Swift source file defines a utility enum 'DebugActions' with various static functions for debugging and development purposes within the macOS app. It includes functions for opening windows, logs, configuration, restarting components, sending notifications, adjusting settings, and managing sessions and processes.

methods.name: openAgentEventsWindow
methods.description: Opens a new window titled 'Agent Events' with a SwiftUI view embedded.

methods.name: openLog
methods.description: Opens the log file in the system's file viewer, shows an alert if the log file is not found.

methods.name: openConfigFolder
methods.description: Opens the configuration folder in the system's file viewer.

methods.name: openSessionStore
methods.description: Opens the session store directory, or its parent if the store file doesn't exist.

methods.name: sendTestNotification
methods.description: Sends a test notification asynchronously.

methods.name: sendDebugVoice
methods.description: Sends a debug voice command and returns the result asynchronously.

methods.name: restartGateway
methods.description: Restarts the gateway depending on the current connection mode, handling local and remote modes.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Resets the SSH tunnel in remote mode, re-establishing the control tunnel.

methods.name: pinoLogPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the pino log file.

methods.name: runHealthCheckNow
methods.description: Triggers an immediate health check.

methods.name: sendTestHeartbeat
methods.description: Sends a test heartbeat message and returns the result.

methods.name: verboseLoggingEnabledMain
methods.description: Checks if verbose logging is enabled in the main context.

methods.name: toggleVerboseLoggingMain
methods.description: Toggles verbose logging setting asynchronously.

methods.name: restartApp
methods.description: Restarts the application.

methods.name: restartOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding flags and restarts onboarding process.

methods.name: resolveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the path to the session store, using configuration or default.

methods.name: recentSessions
methods.description: Fetches recent sessions up to a limit asynchronously.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates session data with provided parameters asynchronously.

methods.name: checkGatewayPorts
methods.description: Diagnoses gateway ports asynchronously.

methods.name: killProcess
methods.description: Kills a process by PID, trying TERM then KILL signals asynchronously.

methods.name: openSessionStoreInCode
methods.description: Opens the session store in code editor.
